title: grammitis geluensis
intro: Grammitis geluensis, commonly known as the Gelu fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Grammitis geluensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic activities, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, although further research is needed to fully understand its pharmacological effects.
